about: What this person told voters in each campaign since 2016: their campaign website as saved by the Wayback Machine just before election day (the homepage and the pages about where they stand), as text, and their campaign-season Bluesky and Threads posts. From scripts/collect-campaign-text.mjs; the promises in it are found by step 2.

pages.text:
## MEET RICHARD
Richard Blumenthal’s #1 priority? Standing up for people and making a difference. He never backs down from a fight or fails to put Connecticut first. No matter how big or powerful the special interest or lawbreaker, protecting Connecticut’s people is always his top priority and purpose.
## THE ISSUES
American families are hurting as costs continue to rise for food, drugs and other essentials. Senator Blumenthal called for a suspension of the federal gas tax and has proposed a windfall profits tax on the big oil companies that are gouging people at the pump.

posts.text: Craven political trashing of Stars & Stripes is a despicable disservice to all Americans, most especially veterans & service members. It reeks of retribution for courageous reporting on the Abraham Lincoln’s abhorrent conditions. It smacks of coverup. www.washingtonpost.com/business/202...

Another inspiring meeting with President Zelenskyy at a critical turning point in Ukraine’s fight for freedom, when they are turning the tide against Russia’s savagery & slaughter. They need air defense interceptors, the Russia sanctions bill, Starlink, & aid.

This brave whistleblower has disclosed dramatic details about USPS’ seemingly illegal plot to undermine November’s midterms. The system is purposefully designed to fail—& risk voting rights for millions of Americans who cast ballots by mail.

Absolutely nothing in the Postal Service’s statement denies or contradicts the deeply disturbing details of the whistleblower’s disclosure. 1/ 
about.usps.com/newsroom/sta...
Instead of an emergency appeal—recklessly prolonging litigation—Trump should simply abandon his insidious new USPS mail ballot rule designed to disenfranchise millions of Americans. 1/
Proud to drive a tractor—joining George Washington on his horse—at the Bridgewater Tractor Parade. Crowds & tractors pulling fun floats braved a few showers.
Spectacular annual Newtown Labor Day parade—cloudless skies, enthusiastic crowds, energetic marchers, all celebrating a great American tradition. Thanks to Newtown's tireless organizers.
Horror & heroism, what we lost & learned—all comes rushing back. Crushing memories of searing grief & shock. Awe at a wondrous unity of purpose & heart. After 25 years, 9/11 is no less real. 1/

More than a voluntary system of independent auditors is necessary for AI oversight. It must be a statutorily established regimen, with power to determine whether models & new products are safe & effective, just as independent scientists are authorized to do under the FDA. 1/

Trump is using crypto to cash in on the presidency—selling access to the highest bidder & raking in the money from foreign governments. We need strong legislation that ends this self-dealing & corruption—not half measures like the Clarity Act.

Americans are being scammed out of billions of dollars while Trump is using crypto to turn the presidency into a profit generating machine. The Clarity Act’s weak rules & carveouts would supercharge fraud & undermine law enforcement.

Great news that the Supreme Court has struck down Trump’s unconstitutional, unconscionable directive using USPS as an instrument to suppress the vote. It never should have been necessary, & his assault on our election system is far from finished.

I’m grateful for the swift signing of this bill & hopeful it will be followed by quick action to implement it. Every day Ukraine remains under a barrage of missile & drone strikes risks more death & destruction on the battlefield&in Ukraine’s cities. www.cbsnews.com/video/trump-...
Happy 79th birthday to the U.S. Air Force! Today we celebrate the brave men & women who fly & fight for our country. Your service & sacrifice help secure our freedom.
On the Senate Judiciary Committee, I’ll be demanding an investigation into Trump’s DOJ protocols & policies concerning dangerous flight risks like Kosta Diamantis. www.courant.com/2026/09/19/k...
Friends at the Orange Fair—enjoying spectacular food, blue skies, rides & more. Always a great time.

Reputable, reliable outlets you’re banning from the White House, Mr. President, don’t “purposely write negative news.” They report accurately on your negative policies that have negative impacts on Americans.
Bringing together Stamford’s diverse, beautiful community, the Longest Table inaugural event was a stupendous success. Hundreds gather to meet, eat, laugh & bond. Thanks to volunteers & supporters!

Russia’s leaders calling the new sanctions law a “Russophobic abomination” shows how scared they are of its potential to throttle oil & gas revenue. Having signed it, Trump must now implement it, aggressively & promptly, to help bring Putin to peace talks.
A reflective, meaningful Yom Kippur to all observing, & an easy fast. May this new year be healthy, peaceful & happy for you & your family.

Proud to stand with Interval House marking the start of Domestic Violence Awareness Month. We must work together to break the cycle of domestic abuse—I'll continue to fight to make sure we have the resources & support needed to combat this scourge.

MDC's Tunnel Pump Station will help prevent untreated stormwater & sewage from flowing into the CT River—huge progress to make the river healthier & our state's environment cleaner. Thank you MDC for your work protecting CT's waterways.
The President’s decision to lift sanctions on Russian diesel is an embarrassment & makes us complicit in Putin’s war against Ukraine. 1/
Trump’s latest investigative ploy is another sign that Yale & other schools need to stand strong— together— not bend & negotiate. thehill.com/homenews/edu...

President Zelenskyy & Ukraine need & deserve magnified American support— not sabotaging insults. Recent Trump Administration threats undercut Ukraine’s brave fight & American security interests. 1/ www.washingtonpost.com/politics/202...
Putting blood money in Putin’s pocket, Trump makes America complicit in Russia’s slaughtering innocent Ukrainians. www.politico.com/news/2026/10...
I’m leading my colleagues in demanding the President rescind the disastrous Russian diesel deal. Appeasement spurs Putin to ignore serious peace talks, & the diesel debacle shows abject weakness. 1/

A perfect storm—home heating oil nearly doubling in price, crushing families hit with higher costs for groceries, gas & everyday necessities. We must demand increased LIHEAP aid, despite Trump attempts to end it. A moral imperative.
Russians call it “human safari.” Their slang for bomb-hunting civilians highlights their abject inhumanity. Another church hit last night— this time in Kramatorsk— killing parishioners.

Concealed contributions, signaling corrupt pay to play— more & larger government contracts, gutted regulations, deep-sixed investigations. I will be expanding my inquiry through the Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations.

www.washingtonpost.com/investigatio...
Greater Danbury NAACP Freedom Fund Dinner drew a sellout crowd & with magnificent honorees. A wonderful celebration of community.

Great visit with the CT State Building Trades Council at their annual convention—representing the lifeblood of our economy. Grateful for the critical work you do, creating training & readiness programs crucial to workforce development & advocating for workers across the state.

Donald Trump confirms again that he stands on the side of a bloodthirsty thug & the enablers of Russia’s war machine & against the majority of Americans, their representatives in both houses of Congress, & our European allies. 1/
apnews.com/article/russ...
Visiting the Kids Play Children’s Museum in Torrington— a wonderful hands-on learning experience with fun & creativity for all ages.
Immigrant Heritage Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony honored extraordinary individuals who came & contributed to our great country. Greatest nation in history—a nation of immigrants.
Interview at Cable 5 TV in Litchfield was enlightening & entertaining—a great resource.
Ridgebury Farm enriches & expands so many lives with its magnificent programs & people. Proud to attend its annual event.
Capacity crowd at Norwalk NAACP Freedom Fund Dinner— bringing together community leaders, public officials, civil rights advocates, & more showing commitment to equity & empowerment.

Republicans must join us in fighting Trump’s abject betrayal of trust & our national security, or they will be complicit in Putin’s slaughter. Inaction is unacceptable. It is a moral moment. www.nytimes.com/2026/10/15/b...
Groundbreaking for the monument tribute to the USS Groton, honoring all who designed, built, maintained, & sailed this historic sub.

THREAD: Joined Senator Tillis today to host an update from President Zelenskyy with bipartisan colleagues—hearing from him highly alarmingly that intelligence sharing & Starshield access are still partially degraded. 1/

Proud to attend American Dream Awards in Danbury celebrating immigrants & their contributions to the greatest country in the world—America is a nation of immigrants. Thank you to the Bacelar-Palmares family!

Without vital air defense interceptors, innocent Ukrainian civilians will suffer spiraling death & destruction from Putin’s bombing. Hegseth & Trump bear blame for their blood. Their complicity & cruelty stain America’s moral standing & national security. www.washingtonpost.com/politics/202...

The nature of warfare is changing—largely due to Ukraine's incredible drone innovation. I saw firsthand Sikorsky’s cutting edge unmanned aerial technology in flying a helicopter equipped with it. An inspiring visit!

Witkoff’s pathetic fawning over this KGB thug betrays American values & security. He should cite Putin’s humanitarian greatness to the prisoners he’s tortured & killed, the children he’s kidnapped, the Ukrainians whose country he’s bombing w/ bloodlust 1/ thehill.com/homenews/adm...

After $330 million privately raised, Trump’s ballroom boondoggle certainly seems like a crooked pay-to-play scheme replete with conflicts of interest & corruption. Americans deserve, & I’m demanding, answers from every donor. www.washingtonpost.com/investigatio...

This bombshell verdict vindicates our cry for justice after disclosure of Facebook & Cambridge Analytics blatant violations of privacy in 2018. Our hearings showed devastating abuses, now resulting in powerful remedies. www.nytimes.com/2026/10/21/t...
A powerful program at the She Leads Justice Constance Baker Motley Award Luncheon. An audience of brave justice advocates!
Congratulations to Quinnipiac University School of Computing & Engineering on your 10th anniversary—a special milestone. Your students are our future.

Voter intimidation in CT & around America has been blocked by this brave federal court ruling—but only temporarily. Trump’s vote suppression campaign is in full swing—with arrayed tactics—requiring a turnout too big to rig. apnews.com/article/trum...

Google is forcing their A.I. products into classrooms across America, & children are paying the price. I'm demanding answers from Google on their relentless push of A.I. products—threatening the academic success & overall wellbeing of our nation's students www.wsj.com/tech/ai/sena...

Small businesses are the backbone of our economy—which is why I'm proud to announce $885,000 for UConn’s Small Business Development Center in East Hartford. This funding will help provide small businesses with the training & resources needed to compete in the digital age.

Ukraine losing access to Starshield raises serious concerns for our national security—like who controls critical capabilities the U.S. government has spent billions to procure & how decisions to restrict them are made. I'm demanding answers from the Department of Defense & SpaceX
Great visit with industry leaders at at the SCSU Innovation HUB Emerging Technologies Forum. We must ensure technology advances create opportunities for innovation & workforce development.
Celebrating the Louis & Gladys Bond Preserve in Montville, an exquisitely beautiful open-space treasure now safe from destructive development.
Standing with workers at the Regional Water Authority in New Haven to demand a fair contract negotiated with their union, the Steelworkers. They deserve good pay, health care, & more.
Proud to attend the Salvation Army’s annual gala in Danbury. Thank you for so many years of kindness, generosity & love—touching countless lives.
Proud to join ARI at its annual dinner to honor Mike Zohdy, owner of the 19th Hole in Stamford, for his wonderful generosity. Thank you ARI for tireless caring & dedication over decades of service.
Record turnout—670 attendees—at the Women's Business Development Council Women Rising Luncheon. Incredible honorees, fabulous organization.

Americans deserve a reckoning—exposing corruption through unstinting investigative sunlight. Secret contract deals, pay to play, pardon schemes, compromising contributions & much more. www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2...

A win for student debt relief—keeping intact the student loan forgiveness program, despite Trump’s efforts to destroy it. People who serve as teachers, police, & more deserve this benefit. www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-d...
I’m sending a sledgehammer message to shipping companies whose tankers are transporting illegal Russian diesel to our ports. Reverse course while there’s still time.

Prediction markets appeal, addict, & endanger young lives—just like sports betting. It’s gambling. Calling out from the casino in your pocket. Pitching kids, problem bettors, all of us. It cries out for regulation, just like gambling. www.nytimes.com/2026/10/28/o...
Standing strong with UAW workers at Triumph fighting for fair compensation, job security, & benefits. Unions are the backbone of our economy—proud to stand with them for this important fight.

I join our nation in mourning the loss of Dolores Huerta—a historic champion for workers' & women's rights. Her steadfast belief in the power of organizing continues to inspire all who fight for justice.
Discovering Amistad is providing awesome education programs about this iconic schooner & its historic role. It will expand & enhance them with a major near $100,000 federal grant we announced today.
Foundation of Hope in Stamford honored 14 community leaders—working hard to give back & provide role models. Thanks to this impressive organization.

Anyone considering buying this “radioactive” Russian diesel should recognize the risks—serious reputation damage&severe legal liability. Congress is watching & a future Administration may not look away from such criminal profiteering, even if this one does www.washingtonsun.com/whitehouse/t...

ICE is terrorizing our communities—now slashing tires of a Portland resident who attempted to shine a light on their abusive behavior. Amid ICE's unlawfulness, the right to bear witness has never been more important to hold our government accountable www.aclu.org/press-releas...

Excited to visit the Ledge Light Health District in New London—announcing a $675,000 grant to The Place for CommUNITY Wellbeing. It enables purchase & renovation of a building for one-stop access to diverse services.
A historic groundbreaking for Enfield’s new train station—a boon to economic growth, job creation, air quality, & travel safety & speed. Glad that federal funding helped make it possible.

Sports betting & prediction markets have exploded—without safeguards to protect people from their addictive & exploitative tactics. Thank you Conard students for your immensely valuable insights in our conversation.

Obscene soaring oil company profits—doubling at Exxon, tripling at Chevron—provide new powerful support for the windfall profits tax I’ve proposed. Put part of those profits back in consumer pockets. www.wsj.com/business/ene...
Moving Domestic Violence Vigil at Greenwich’s YWCA honoring amazing advocates & leaders. Honored to join you.

We made a promise to our Afghan allies—that after aiding & protecting our troops during the conflict in Afghanistan, America would not abandon them. This Administration is betraying that promise, deporting them to potential torture & death. www.nytimes.com/2026/10/30/w...
A powerful partnership between Middletown’s Community Health Center & New Horizons Domestic Violence Services at their fundraising event Hope Grows Here. A magnificent greenhouse!

Sending federal election monitors to New Haven is more about intimidating voters than protecting election integrity. There is no evidence of fraud or illegality—not a scintilla—that justifies this overreaching by a DOJ that should be pursuing real wrongdoing.
Dress for Success fashion benefit was a huge success— helping 9,000 women over the past 21 years enter the workforce. Thanks to great leaders!
Thinking of my great friend & colleague, Chris Murphy. I know how fiercely he fights & I'm certain I'll be welcoming him back to the Senate soon.

Continuing strong support for UAW workers at Triumph as they strike for better wages, health care & working conditions. This defense contractor must recognize their employees’ value & justly compensate them.

Google is once again prioritizing profits over people—this time blocking schools from using Google Search unless they opt into their A.I. overview. Clearly, the Tech Giant is more concerned with forcing Gemini into schools than enabling students to succeed www.nytimes.com/2026/11/03/u...
